notes.title: Major Update - 27/06
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow gamers!

We're super excited to share our latest update, and trust us, it's a big one. We've packed it with all sorts of goodies to make your gaming experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Smarter AI[/b] - Tired of the AI making dumb moves? Not anymore! We’ve given our AI a major brain boost.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] - Get ready for some multiplayer mayhem! You can now play with your Steam friends. Woohoo!
[*][b]In-Game Feedback Panel[/b] - Got something to say? Now you can tell us what you think without ever leaving the game. We’re all ears (or, you know, eyes).
[*][b]Detailed End Result Screen[/b] - More stats, more details, more satisfaction. Check out the new end result screen for a full breakdown of your performance.
[*][b]Mercy for the defeated[/b] - Lost a betli or durchmarsch on your second turn? No need to suffer through the rest. These games will now end automatically when the solo player loses. You're welcome!
[*][b]Forfeit option[/b] - Stuck in a hopeless game? Now you can gracefully bow out and move on to the next challenge.
[*][b]Extermination[/b] - We’ve hunted down and squashed those pesky bugs you reported. The invisible text issue on Mac? Gone. We hope... Thanks for helping us make the game better!
[/list]

So, what are you waiting for? Get your buddies and start dealing those cards! And as always, keep the feedback coming. We’re here to make this game the best it can be, with your help.

Game on!

PS: The [b]Hungarian voice over [/b]sadly did not make it to this update, but it is very close to being finished. If you want to check out where it is now, you can do so by switching to the "preview" beta in your Steam client! You can always switch back to the standard version, anytime you want. Just don't forget to set the audio language back to English [b]BEFORE [/b]changing versions!
